# Best MagSafe Car Charger Mounts (Late 2026)

**For most people, get the Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount.** If you want faster charging and better cooling, get the Anker Prime. If you want the lowest price with a cooling fan, get the ESR HaloLock CryoBoost.

| Pick | Best for | Charging | Price seen | Adapter included? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 Vent Mount** | Most iPhone drivers | Qi2, 15W | $47.99 | Yes, 27W plus cable |
| **Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933)** | Fastest charging, best cooling | Qi2, 25W | $89.99 list, $69.99 on sale (June) | Yes, 60W (per reviews) |
| **ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost** | Budget pick with a cooling fan | Qi2, 15W | $18.99 on Amazon (June) to $39.99 at ESR | No |

## 1. Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount: best overall
- It charges at the standard Qi2 15W, rotates between portrait and landscape, and works with cases up to 3 mm thick.
- The box includes a 27W car adapter and a USB-C cable, so you don't need to buy anything else.
- **Check your vents first.** Belkin's support documents say slats should be at most 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Horizontal slats work best, and vertical slats can sag under the weight.
- If your vents won't work, Belkin sells a **Vent/Dash version** for the same $47.99.
- Sources: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

## 2. Anker Prime MagGo AirCool: fastest charging
- It charges at Qi2 25W and uses thermoelectric cooling plus a fan, so your phone stays cool while running navigation in the sun. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) uses it as their daily mount.
- **Full 25W only works on certain phones:**
  - iPhone 17, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus: up to 25W
  - iPhone 16 and 16 Pro: up to 22W
  - iPhone 15 and older: around 15W
  - iPhone 16e: not compatible
- **It needs a 45W or stronger USB-C power source** to reach full speed.
- **It does not fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vehicles.** The vent clamp fits slats 10 to 24 mm deep.
- Sources: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

## 3. ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost: best value with a fan
- It charges at Qi2 15W and has a built-in fan. It can clip to a vent or stick to the dashboard. It is Qi2 certified (Qi-ID 21376).
- **No car adapter is included.** Budget about $10 to $15 for an 18W or stronger one.
- **Prices vary a lot:**
  - [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) listed it at $18.99 on Amazon in June. Check Amazon first, since this may still be the cheapest option.
  - [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) lists it at $39.99 on ESR's own store. Code **PARTNER18** brings it to $32.80, and Dealectric says they tested the code on Oct 22. Their buy link is [dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through it.

## If you'd rather not use a vent
- **iOttie Velox Mini Qi2** (~$41): mounts on the dash or windshield and includes a charger. Covered by [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/).

**About buy links:** my search results didn't include direct store pages for the Belkin, Anker or iOttie mounts. The review articles linked above have "Buy" buttons, or you can search the exact product name on Amazon. Prices in those articles date from June to August, so check the current price at checkout.

If you tell me your iPhone model and car, I can narrow this down to one pick.
